Satay Ayam.note: Chicken; kuah kacang = roasted peanuts + a little belacan (crustaceans). Marinade spices only. 'Mildly spicy' = 1. JAKIM-certified kitchen.

Satay Daging.note: Beef; kicap manis marinade = soy + gluten; kuah kacang = roasted peanuts + a little belacan (crustaceans). Mildly spicy = 1.

Satay Kambing.note: Lamb basted with ghee = milk (hidden); kuah kacang = roasted peanuts + a little belacan (crustaceans). Mildly spicy = 1.

Satay Perut.note: Beef tripe; kuah kacang = roasted peanuts + a little belacan (crustaceans). Mildly spicy = 1.

Satay Tempe.note: Tempe = soy. Sounds vegetarian but the kuah kacang = roasted peanuts + a little belacan (crustaceans), so not vegetarian or vegan. Mildly spicy = 1.

Satay Campur Set.note: Chicken, beef (kicap manis = soy + gluten) and lamb (ghee = milk); kuah kacang = roasted peanuts + a little belacan (crustaceans); nasi impit. Mildly spicy = 1.

Nasi Impit.note: Plain compressed rice. Extra kuah kacang is an add-on, not part of the dish.

Ketupat.note: Plain rice in a coconut-leaf pouch.

Ayam Percik.note: Chicken; percik sauce with belacan = crustaceans; coconut milk is not milk. Mildly spicy = 1.

Mee Rebus.note: Yellow egg noodles = gluten + egg; beef stock; dried shrimp = crustaceans; taucu and fried tofu = soy; boiled egg. Green chilli garnish with no heat word = 1.

Mee Sup Sayur.note: Sounds vegetarian but the broth is ikan bilis = fish. Wheat noodles stated egg-free = gluten; fried tofu = soy. Not spicy.

Nasi Goreng Kampung.note: Ikan bilis = fish; belacan = crustaceans; fried egg; soy sauce = soy + gluten. Spicy = 2.

Sambal Sotong.note: Squid = molluscs; belacan = crustaceans. Very spicy = 3.

Tauhu Bakar.note: Tofu = soy; kicap manis = soy + gluten; peanut sauce; stated no belacan, so vegan. Mildly spicy = 1.

Cucur Udang.note: Prawns; wheat-flour batter. Chilli sauce with no heat word = 1.

Pisang Goreng.note: Wheat flour in the batter; stated no egg; vegan.

Murtabak Daging.note: Wheat dough, minced beef, egg; dhal curry cooked in ghee = milk. Mildly spicy = 1. Ramadan bazaar only.

Bubur Lambuk.note: Minced beef; dried shrimp = crustaceans; coconut milk is not milk. Not spicy. Ramadan bazaar only.

Air Katira.note: Evaporated milk. Katira gum and basil seeds are plant-based. Ramadan bazaar only.

Cendol.note: Rice-flour jelly, red beans, coconut milk (not milk), gula Melaka.

Cendol Pulut Durian.note: Cendol plus glutinous rice (no gluten) and durian.

Ais Kacang.note: Roasted peanuts; evaporated milk. Sold out in branch settings.

Kopi O.note: Beans roasted with butter = milk (rule o): vegetarian, not vegan.

Air Kelapa.note: Coconut water and flesh; coconut is not a tree nut.
